stage: 1: the four secret backstories (backstory_*.json), then the public lore

how_to_read.tier: stated = the words are in the text; inferred = only implied (offered to the DM as a suggestion, never extracted as a fact); by_rule = made by a rule, not read
how_to_read.relation: parent_of, grandparent_of, sibling, spouse, uncle_of, apprentice_of, mentor_of, owns, carries, knows (+ one of nine feeling words), member, leads, works_for, enemy_of, rival_of, held_captive_by, found, associate; place ties by word: lives_in, lived_in, works_in, comes_from, last_seen_in (a character, creature or group), kept_in, was_kept_in (an item); in (only a place inside a place)
how_to_read.direction: a to b: parent_of (a is the parent), owns (a owns b), leads (a leads b), member (a belongs to b), in (a place is inside place b); sibling, spouse and rival_of read the same both ways
how_to_read.must_find: false = a good find if present, not a miss if absent; an inferred tie that must be found is scored as an offered suggestion
how_to_read.current: false = history: it was true and is not now (the graph shows the most recent relationship, #3363)
how_to_read.line: the line of the document's plain-text export that supports it (blank lines count)
how_to_read.map_facts: a place's land, climate or ruler (#4256): layer terrain, climate or control; value a word of that layer's list, or the ruling group's key name; scored per layer as found, wrong, missed and extra (a row the key does not list)
how_to_read.languages: a character's languages are a property of the character, never a tie (owner, 2026-11-14; #4229): {character, language, line, note}; scored as found, missed, and extra (a language the key does not list)
how_to_read.threads: a story thread (quests design, #4450 §9.3; #4453): kind quest, hook or mystery; giver, target and taker (who takes it on, for a pursuit that is one character's own) are key names; missing and in_danger list who the thread is about. The party is never named: a thread is the party's unless it has a taker. hint = a question the text leaves open, counted when found and never missed. Scored as found, missed, wrong (another kind), doubles and extra (a thread the key does not list)
how_to_read.knowers: who knows each row (#4523): "everyone" = common knowledge, the world's (#4537); "party" = the four player characters, told as their own story. The player characters' backgrounds here are the party's: what they state from a secret backstory becomes the party's (see reveals)
how_to_read.reveals: each lore row, event or thread id, and the backstory key rows (backstory_*.json) it makes known to its knowers; every backstory row not listed stays its own knowers' secret. A backstory node is revealed when this key has a node of the same name or alias. Judged by what the lore says, row by row, never by matching ends alone (the lore's rival_of Wit is not the backstory's respect)
how_to_read.thread_knowers: the lore's threads are all the party's: "thread_knowers"
how_to_read.in: the documents a row is stated in; sources gives each one's row and line
how_to_read.also: an event or thread a backstory tells too, with its row
how_to_read.built: built by `python -m dmbot.devtools.build_keys`: never edit by hand

events.what: Master Sparkwalker disappears, Wit comes back fatally wounded, and Cerric flees to Neverwinter with the tome
Vaelrith vanishes at 105, leaving a bloodstained campsite
Claude erases his own memory, is held by a circus and escapes
Hlin Trollbane offers the party a contract on Sephek Kaltro in The Lucky Liar
events.who: the party, Hlin Trollbane, Sephek Kaltro

events.what: The party fights six ice kobolds and evades a yeti on the road to Termalaine
Rumours reach the party that an evil wizard captured in Easthaven will be burned at the stake
The grell paralyzes Claude and destroys Glyph, then the party kills it
Okthandom kills Trex with an arrow, and Claude burns Penolopi to banish the ghost
The party secures the spoils of the mine, including a psi crystal and a heart of chardalyn
Speaker Masthew pays a bounty of 250 gold for clearing the mine
Claude sells the wolf figurine to Belleros for 75 gold
An ice troll devours the first ship's captain and shatters his ship
Cerric talks Okthandom into pushing Fizzlebomb overboard; Belleros runs the Aurora's Wind ashore
Three owlbears ambush the party near Targos
Belleros befriends Boy, who leads the party to Keegan Velryn; she asks them to find Garret
events.who: Belleros, Boy, Keegan Velryn, Garret Velryn

events.what: Every ten-day Targos, Bryn Shander and Easthaven sacrifice humanoid souls, spellcasters first, to appease Auril
Every ten-day Termalaine, Bremen and Good Mead forsake all warmth in a Sacrifice of Warmth
Every ten-day Caer-Dineval, Caer-Konig and Lonelywood fast and surrender their food to the beasts of the tundra
Each night before midnight Auril casts the spell that keeps the sun from rising: the Everlasting Rime
Valyra leaves for her apprenticeship and the siblings stop meeting
The grandfather dies in a storm; Qinric visits and Cerric becomes the spire's steward
Emmerich, then Wit, leave to look for the master
He breaks the lock with the bust, and a figure enters as he leaves
A shattered family talisman is left at his campsite
Nyssara confesses the whispers have started for her
The ringmaster dies in Claude's cage
He swears the Explorer's Oath
After a narrow escape from a ruin he trains as a ranger of the Ward
Shimmergloom destroys Mithral Hall and scatters his people
